concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-intelligent-money-movement]] — 2026-09-15 enterprise Intelligent Money Movement overview for payment processing, merchant-to-balance-account funds flow, enterprise accounts, third-party payouts and issued-card spending; distinct from this concept's platform-user financial-product family, with no account-specific enablement or execution proof.
warnings: IMM is expressly framed as enterprise cash management; do not merge its enterprise flow with the platform-user Financial Products architecture or infer a merchant/legal-role mapping.
The high-level page provides no live eligibility, product activation, API implementation, beneficiary receipt or issued-card transaction evidence.
